sql: select c.name, c.settings->'enabled_modules'->'ia_conversacional' as modulo, s.enabled, (select count(*) from pg_trigger where tgname in ('protect_ai_conversational_module','disable_ai_agent_when_module_off','require_ai_conversational_module')) as triggers from public.companies c left join public.ai_agent_settings s on s.company_id = c.id where c.settings->'enabled_modules'->>'ia_conversacional' = 'true' or s.company_id is not null
